title: myrosma lutea
intro: Myrosma lutea, commonly known as Yellow Myrosma, is a flowering plant species native to tropical regions. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Myrosma lutea include wound healing, pain relief, and immune system support. Bioactive constituents found in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
